text:
amira: FYI Prod Search submitted cormorant-42b for ranking + rerank. Request: high-quality, reduce hallucinations on entity extraction. Can we triage this week? :eyes:
kevin: assigning initial owner -> song. I'll add to model intake board.
song: I can run baseline evals tomorrow. Need top-line metrics: MRR, exact-match, toxicity, perplexity on our logs. Any specific slices?
priya: pls check rare entity coverage slice (org names <10 occurrences). Also measure prefix caching behavior.
amira: timeline: product asks for canary in 3w. If quantization required, factor in extra shoe time.
song: plan: 1) bring up fp16 single node; 2) run eval harness; 3) try int8/awq. I'll use existing quant profile `q-prof-2025-v2`.
kevin: budget/priority: this maps to Q2 roadmap (search ranking). Score: 8/10 priority. Can we get latency <120ms p99 on dedicated?
jon: FYI caching + continuous batching might help — tag for eng-runtime.
song: quick note on infra: I'm seeing OOM on 32k context with fp16 on a8x. Will try model parallel split.
matt: assigning SLO owners — @kevin can you confirm SLA for prod search?
kevin: confirmed SLA 99.9% with 200ms median, ok for canary.
priya: eval harness command:
```
./run_eval.sh --model cormorant-42b --slices rare_entities,dialogue --quant profile=q-prof-2025-v2 --out results.json
```
song: run started 2037501245. partial logs:
```
INFO loading model weights...
WARN KV cache warmup 30%
ERROR tokenizer mismatch for special token <cust_ent>, mapping fallback
```
amira: token issue maybe from tokenizer vocab differences. Priya can you add mapping to the tokenizer step, or we fall back to generic.
priya: I'll patch tokenizer mapping and re-run by EOD.
eval-bot: eval run completed — overall MRR delta vs baseline -0.02, EM +0.05 on rare_entities, latency p99 180ms fp16.
kevin: EM gain on rare_entities is promising but p99 is over target. Song, can you try batching tweaks / prefix cache settings?
song: yes will try `--max-batch 16 --cache-prefix 1000` and test awq int8.
priya: also don't forget safety evals — inject adversarial prompts for extraction.
amira: thanks team. We'll reconvene sync in 2 days. :rocket:
